reviews.text: The best vet practice in NYC by far, have trusted them for almost ten years now.

We’ve been taking our senior cat here for 3 years and have been very happy with the treatment. She had early diabetes and we developed a treatment plan with Dr Adelman that essentially has put her in remission. Recently we came with another litter box issue and Dr Adelman successful diagnosed as arthritis and our cat is feeling so much better! It’s a joy to see her run around again. Have always had a great experience with the front desk as well.

We are so grateful to VH Brooklyn Heights for the exceptional love and care they have always shown Piper and for their endless support and patience as we navigate her last chapter...
Piper just adores going to the vet!!

So kind, caring and professional. The doctors and staff have always gone above and beyond to make sure my wife and I understand every nuanced detail and that we’re best informed to make difficult decisions when necessary. The routine visits are genuinely a pleasure and our cats love whole team.
Wouldn’t go anywhere else with my loves!

I've been coming to VHV for a few years now. My pets have always been seen by Dr. Gowda (highly suggest booking with if possible). Everyone in the office is always so sweet and amenable to all of our needs! Highly recommend.

I want to be able to say something better but they misdiagnosed a cancer diagnosis in my dog that would have been fatal if I followed their instructions to “keep a food log” instead of seeking a second opinion and they also started my him on heart medication that another cardiologist said he never needed years later so idk.
I feel so comfortable bringing Pearl here… the staff are kind and excited to see her. The vets are caring and informative making our check ups and nail trims trips easy.
I feel so comfortable bringing Pearl here… the staff are kind and excited to see her. The vets are caring and informative making our check ups and nail trims trips easy.
I can’t say enough wonderful things about this practice. The care they gave my cat until the end was phenomenal. Every vet is excellent, gentle, and compassionate. I will only take my animals here.

VHVG provides okay care, with frustrating billing practices - a pattern that's common in vet medicine, but pronounced here. Three months in, puppy vaccines for one dog and establishing care for the other. The care itself has been fine, enjoyed working with Dr. Pham. Otherwise its a pretty mid clinic, and I found their front desk staff to be quite cold and unfriendly.

The main issue I have with VHVG is their billing practices, which require constant vigilance to avoid being needlessly upsold or overcharged. Our puppy's vaccine series required several separate visits, and they [attempted] to route each one through a full doctor's exam fee - just to give a shot. Separately, I asked for a tech-only blood draw on our other dog for a routine annual blood test, despite the fact we brought her in for a wellness visit with the DVM [3] months prior, I was told a doctor exam was required. No explanation was given, just a pitch for a paid monthly membership.

I've had dogs all my life, and my partner and I own a [human] medical practice ourselves - we're no strangers to both veterinary norms and to the operational and financial demands of running a medical office. Even so, we found their insistence on billing an exam fee at nearly every turn to be either greedy or inefficient - neither of which reflects very well on how the practice is run. Their overall pricing also runs high, even by NYC standards. Add insult to injury, they charge a 3% credit card surcharge on every transaction, which for vet bills is expensive and also feels like an unnecessarily hostile business practice - this is a cost of doing business. As a business owner myself, I can tell you they are likely profiting on a fee, simply to pay them.

We've since decided to move our routine care elsewhere, and I recommend other potential customers/patients find veterinary care that separates routine services from full doctor exams, so you're not paying comprehensive exam fees just to get a shot or a blood draw.

Very unprofessional staff

If you want your exotic pet to recover, stay away from this place!

I spoke with them over the phone, and they told me they could see my pet as an emergency because they had no appointments available. They said the emergency exam would cost $275 and that the doctor would be able to see my pet.

When I arrived, the woman at the front desk was very cold. She handed me a form to fill out, and while I was doing that, she was busy talking to her coworker about another customer, an elderly woman who had "given her a hard time" because her cat was about to die. She clearly didn't seem to care whether that cat survived or not.

After I finished the paperwork, she quickly went into the back, came back about 10 seconds later, and told me the doctor couldn't see my pet after all. She said I would have to wait until the next day, when "another doctor" would be available, despite the fact that I had been told over the phone that my pet could be seen that day!!

I told her I wasn't sure my pet would survive until tomorrow, and all she said was, "There's nothing I can do."

This experience was completely unprofessional and showed a shocking lack of compassion for both pets and their owners.

Amazing Vet!
They’re always so sweet and take such good care of my rabbit! My rabbit has been coming here since he was a baby (4 years ago), and don’t plan on changing vets ever!

I have gotten dogs treated by a lot of vets over the years, no one has ever given my dog better care and me more clear and supportive consultation than Dr. Matan Paradis. Over the last several years, Dr. Paradis has offered compassionate, clear, and consistent care to our dog who has a serious illness. He always takes the time to review test results with us in detail and I trust that he is giving us the best advice possible taking into consideration our dog's specific situation. Most recently, Dr. Paradis went above and beyond to contact us with test results on Saturday July 4, just to make sure we didn't spent the weekend worrying/with a dog in distress. I can't recommend him enough.

Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group has been an incredible vet for my 7-year-old dog, Yoshi. Their team is attentive, responsive, and genuinely compassionate. Whether it's a routine checkup or a more serious issue, I know Yoshi is always in great hands.

A few years ago, Yoshi chipped a tooth and needed a root canal. The team at Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group referred us to an excellent veterinary dentist in Manhattan, and thanks to their recommendation, his tooth was saved and he made a full recovery.

We also love being Wellness Plan members. It includes services like nail trims, ear cleanings, anal gland expressions, and veterinary visits whenever we need them, which has been incredibly convenient.

If you're looking for a reliable neighborhood veterinarian that truly cares about your pet, I highly recommend Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group, especially the DUMBO location.
Love the vets! Done so much for my dogs and rats. But since 12/25 I am being charged 3% surcharge to my credit card that is NOT disclosed on my invoices. ??????
Great vet. Friendliest staff.
The vets here are great, they really care about the well being of our pets.

Our pets have all been cared for at Vinegar Hill vets, and we’ve always had a great experience. All of the vets are nice and experienced, and so are the techs. Their hours are extended so getting an appointment is never an issue. Their costs seem very fair and they are always upfront about costs with no pressure selling. Highly recommend.

We had been taking our 14.5-year-old dog to Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group on and off for basically his entire life, and it is heartbreaking to see how far this place has declined.
What used to feel like a caring neighborhood vet now feels completely money-driven, with unnecessary treatments constantly pushed and a staff that has become shockingly rude and dismissive. The compassion and professionalism are gone.
The final straw was when Chewy contacted them for records and the staff repeatedly acted as though we were never even patients there because they “couldn’t find records.” Instead of being helpful or kind, they were cold and difficult. When we personally requested records, they randomly sent documents no explanation, no communication thread, nothing.
The new doctors have also been extremely disappointing. One actually told me there was essentially no point in helping my dog’s eye issues because he is “old anyway.” That comment alone was disgusting and completely unacceptable. A 14-year-old dog still deserves comfort, care, dignity, and a vet who actually cares.
We now go to specialists and practices that truly care about animals, including Animal Cardiology Specialists, Veterinary Eye Center, Prospect Heights Animal Hospital, and Williamsburg Veterinary Clinic, and the difference in compassion and professionalism is night and day.
I would absolutely never recommend Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group to anyone anymore. If you truly care about your pets, stay far away.

Greedy clinic. I went in for help after my 16-year-old dog ran out of her heart medication, putting her at risk of heart failure. I brought a recent prescription from her vet and simply asked if they could sell me enough medication to bridge the gap until her refill arrives. Despite knowing she had no pills left, they refused and said they would need to do their “own evaluation” before prescribing anything, but couldn’t see her until another day.

Completely out of touch and lacking compassion. Instead of helping an elderly dog in urgent need, they seemed more interested in charging for another visit. Disgusting and inhumane behavior.
Dr. O’Sullivan is amazing and so gentle with my shy dog Leo! He gets exceptional care at every visit. We’re so glad we found a practice we can trust in the area.
very positive complete confidence in your care
Fabulous
Thank you Dr. Neuman, Sebastian, and Fanni.
The Veterinary staff is knowledgeable and personable. We primarily use the Brooklyn Heights location. They take great care of my pup Bubba! I highly recommend them!
Everyone is very friendly and super fast for nail trim! Poppy had a great time

I have been going to vinegar hill vet for only less than a year, but they take such good care of my kitty! Every time I visit them, they take the time to explain everything thoroughly, and as well on the phone.
Dr Pham is so sweet, and she did my kitty’s dental extraction. Dr Paradis is also so caring. The front desk folks are all so kind, and patient, even when I ask loads of questions. I know that when I drop off my kitty he is in good hands. Highly recommend!

PS the vet is so clean, much cleaner than the other places I’ve been to!
Dr Neuman and Dr Adelman are the most caring doctors.
This vet group saved my cat’s life. They diagnosed him with FIP and got him on medication immediately. They were so wonderful and helpful. Can’t recommend them enough.
Fantastic doctors and staff! Well run. Never crazy inside. My dog is very complicated and I would never trust him anywhere else.

We have been coming here for 5 years, and they have always treated my dog Frida with the greatest care! We love Doctor Gowda, and still make the trip  from the upper east side after moving neighborhoods! Can’t recommend enough!

Everyone was so kind and friendly. We brought our foster cat in for x-rays. Dr Wong did a thorough exam and listened to my concerns before our cat went in for the test. It was a very pleasant experience.

Great vet group
Shared in both locations
Experience was amazing! They treat my sweet bunny with much kindness and patience! That’s all we can ask for!
Excellent vet!!

It's tough to put into words how awesome this place is, but let me just say I've been to quite a few vets around Brooklyn and Manhattan, and Vinegar Hill vet group is fab! I use the Brooklyn Heights location most of the time, and everyone is super friendly as well as extremely knowledgeable. The front desk staff is amazing especially Fani (I think I'm spelling that right!). They're all very patient with my Shep as well as my two cats, and when the euthanasia time came for my previous Shep..... well, let's just say they made a horrible time in my life bearable. I cannot recommend them enough, I love Dr Newman best but they are all praise worthy, and I trust all the techs even with nail trims on my one cat from hell haha. If you are looking for a new vet, I promise you you will not be disappointed. I'm very very picky but even I can't complain at all coming here!

I have been going to Vinegar Hill Vet Group in Brooklyn heights for 15 years and they are like family. They love my dogs as if they are their own. Dr. Neuman has provided so much medical and emotional support over the year. She is incredibly knowledgeable, presents information in a digestible way, and provides all options available for treatment, taking into consideration both cost and my dogs’ quality of life. There are many vet practices in the area but I have continued to go to Vinegar Hill even if I have moved farther away because of how deeply I trust them. Her and the staff go out of their way and above and beyond to support both my dogs and I. Fani, the receptionist treats my dogs as if they are her own. The staff at the Brooklyn Heights location light up when they see my dogs and I can tell how much they love their jobs and getting to make these connections. I recently had to put one of my dogs to sleep and I couldn’t have gotten through it without them. I chose to do it in my home with Dr. Neuman. She had spent so much time treating my dog that she knew it was difficult to get an iv in her and made sure to come with the vet tech that is the best of everyone in the group at finding a vein. She and Chris made sure I could make this transition at home, which was so important to me. I cannot recommend these vets enough.
